colaborar.018091.t: For countries, Links to other records connects kingdoms to each other (predecessor, successor, part of, includes, territorial ancestor): you pick the other record from a list, and the reverse link is written into it automatically. That way, when you follow Spain on the map, Castile, Aragon and Navarre light up too in their own time.

colaborar.020f77.t: Negative years are BC, coordinates are always [latitud, longitud] and almost every field is optional. Borders are separate GeoJSON files, from historical-basemaps.

colaborar.18df57.t: It only works on your own computer. The published site has no panel and doesn’t save changes: download the project, edit the records locally with the assistant, and propose your changes with a pull request on GitHub. They’re published once someone on the project reviews and merges them.

colaborar.1f636d.t: Before the pull request, git diff shows you exactly what the assistant has written. If someone else changed the same record while you were editing it, the assistant won't overwrite it and asks you to reload. For countries and conflicts, the Identifier can't be changed from here, and zone polygons are edited as text.
